OBI Real Estate: The World's First 0% Commission Social Real Estate Marketplace Application 

Real estate is one of the largest industries in the world, yet buying and selling property remains expensive, fragmented, and inefficient.

Today, people search for homes on one platform, market properties on another, communicate through separate channels, hire service providers elsewhere, and often pay commissions that can reach tens of thousands of dollars on a single transaction.

OBI Real Estate is changing that.

OBI is building an all-in-one real estate ecosystem that combines the marketplace power of Facebook Marketplace, the property discovery experience of Zillow, the engagement of TikTok, and the connectivity of Uber into a single AI-powered platform.

Our mission is simple:

Make buying and selling real estate faster, cheaper, and more accessible for everyone.

One Platform. Everything Real Estate.

OBI brings together buyers, sellers, Obi operators (example uber drivers), photographers, inspectors, contractors, lenders, marketers, and service providers inside one unified marketplace.

Instead of navigating multiple apps and intermediaries, users can discover properties, market listings, connect directly, and complete transactions within a single ecosystem.

The platform is designed to support:

• Property buying and selling
• Residential and commercial listings
• Short-form video property marketing
• Social engagement and content discovery
• AI-powered property search and recommendations
• Direct messaging and negotiations
• Service provider marketplace
• Fiat and cryptocurrency payments
• Smart contract-powered transaction infrastructure
• AI-assisted workflows and automation

OBI transforms real estate from a fragmented process into a connected digital economy.

Live Today — Built and Already in Market

OBI Real Estate is already live on the Apple App Store and Google Play Store, with the first phase of the platform currently available to users.

This live version establishes the foundation of the ecosystem and focuses on early platform functionality, user engagement, and real-world testing of the core experience.

We are currently building the next major phase of OBI: the full AI-powered social real estate marketplace.

This upcoming phase will expand OBI into a complete end-to-end ecosystem for real estate, including:

• Full property listing marketplace
• Social media-style property content feed
• Short-form video property discovery
• Direct buyer, seller, and agent interaction
• AI-driven matching and recommendations
• Integrated fiat and crypto payments
• Expanded service provider network
• End-to-end transaction workflows

This next phase is targeted for release later this year, evolving OBI from early-stage platform into a fully integrated global real estate marketplace.

The End of Traditional Commission Structures

Traditional real estate transactions often involve commission models that significantly increase costs for buyers and sellers while creating unnecessary friction throughout the process.

OBI introduces a new approach.

A technology-driven marketplace where users can connect directly and leverage automation to reduce costs while maintaining transparency and efficiency.

Our goal is to help create a future where real estate transactions are more accessible, more efficient, and significantly less expensive than traditional models.

Powered by Artificial Intelligence

Artificial intelligence is integrated throughout the OBI ecosystem.

AI tools will help users:

• Discover properties faster
• Generate listing descriptions and marketing content
• Analyze market opportunities
• Match buyers, sellers, and service providers
• Recommend relevant listings and services
• Streamline transaction workflows
• Reduce administrative friction

As the platform evolves, AI will play an increasingly important role in simplifying and automating real estate interactions.

Bridging Digital Payments and Real Estate

OBI is designed to support both traditional fiat payments and cryptocurrency, allowing users to transact using the payment methods that best fit their needs. Off-ramp your SOL, XRP, ADA, or even you OBI utility token and many other cryptos into single family residences, multifamily apartments and many other real world assets all inside the Obi Real Estate App. 

By connecting digital finance with real-world property transactions, OBI creates a seamless, modern payment layer for global real estate commerce.

The OBI Utility Token

At the center of the ecosystem is the OBI Utility Token.

The OBI token powers the platform and serves as the native utility asset required for key marketplace functions.

The OBI token is used for:

• Marketplace transaction fees
• Property listing fees
• AI-powered platform services
• Verification and authentication services
• Smart contract execution
• Premium platform features
• Future automated transaction services

Every transaction and service performed within the ecosystem contributes to token utility and platform activity.

The token is designed around real usage, real demand, and real marketplace participation.

Fixed Supply

The OBI Utility Token has a fixed maximum supply of 1 billion tokens.

No inflation.
No unlimited minting.

A utility-driven asset designed to support a growing global real estate marketplace.

The Long-Term Vision

OBI is building more than a property listing platform.

Our vision is to create the digital infrastructure for the next generation of real estate transactions.

A world where buyers, sellers, agents, and service providers can connect instantly.

A world where AI reduces complexity and friction.

A world where real estate operates as a connected global marketplace.

A world where transactions happen faster, more transparently, and more efficiently than ever before.

Why OBI Is Building on Solana

OBI Real Estate is being built on the Solana ecosystem because of its high performance, scalability, and extremely low transaction costs, making it well-suited for large-scale, real-world consumer applications.

As OBI scales into a high-volume global marketplace, performance, cost efficiency, and transaction speed are essential to delivering a seamless user experience for both fiat and crypto payments.

Solana provides the infrastructure needed to support fast, low-cost transactions at global scale, aligning with OBI’s goal of building a real-time, high-frequency marketplace for real estate activity.

We are also aligned with the broader direction of the Solana ecosystem as it continues to expand toward mobile-first and consumer-driven blockchain applications. As digital commerce increasingly shifts toward mobile-native experiences, we see strong alignment between that direction and OBI’s vision of a fully mobile, AI-powered real estate marketplace.

By building on Solana, OBI positions itself within one of the most performance-focused blockchain ecosystems while focusing on delivering real-world utility through a mainstream consumer application.

OBI Real Estate

The future of real estate is not fragmented across dozens of platforms.

It exists in one place.

One marketplace.
One ecosystem.
Powered by AI.
Built for speed.
Designed for global access.

OBI Real Estate.
